gaps.evidence: Analysis places Duolingo Hindi around A1–A2 and identifies natural-speed, script-speed, Hinglish and register needs.
gaps.problem: Learners cannot infer B2–C2 productive mastery from path completion.
gaps.ekguru_opportunity: Build explicit B1–C2 source-based reading/listening, professional genres, inference, style and externally moderated production.

gaps.evidence: HindiPod101 documents 1,370+ audio/video lessons, PDFs, SRS and assessments; independent analysis recommends combining it with tutors/native material for unpredictable interaction.
gaps.problem: Large inventory can remain uneven across productive skills and CEFR outcomes.
gaps.ekguru_opportunity: Map every asset to can-do outcomes; require live/branching interaction and performance portfolio.

gaps.evidence: Glossika centers native sentence SRS; independent review reports repetitive sessions and recording without corrective judgment.
gaps.problem: Automatized repetition does not establish interaction, explanation or reliable pronunciation.
gaps.ekguru_opportunity: Limit fluency sets, add explicit contrasts, ASR confidence, transfer roleplays and human escalation.

gaps.evidence: Anki schedules cards but learners/authors control card content.
gaps.problem: Bad, ambiguous or oversized cards are efficiently memorized too.
gaps.ekguru_opportunity: Course-authored card eligibility rules, source IDs, one retrieval target, leech repair and audits.

gaps.evidence: Duolingo reports integrated skills and section quizzes; its study found receptive outcomes generally stronger than productive outcomes in beginner courses.
gaps.problem: High lesson accuracy can hide weak spontaneous speaking/writing.
gaps.ekguru_opportunity: Separate skill thresholds and require unseen productive performances for promotion.

gaps.evidence: Products variously use native recording, record/compare, TTS and ASR; these are not equivalent evidence.
gaps.problem: Learners may mistake transcription success or synthetic fluency for pronunciation quality/native input.
gaps.ekguru_opportunity: Asset provenance labels, confidence-aware ASR, native core recordings and human review in high stakes.

gaps.evidence: Hindi analysis notes functional reading speed remains a post-intro need; HindiPod101’s dedicated script path is useful but cannot judge articulation.
gaps.problem: Letter recognition does not ensure handwriting, typing, dictation or fluent reading.
gaps.ekguru_opportunity: A1 script lab plus A2 speed benchmarks and later integrated dictation/typing remediation.

gaps.evidence: Hindi gap analysis identifies आप/तुम and Hinglish; grammar references document honorific and register systems.
gaps.problem: Textbook-only Hindi leaves learners unable to interpret relationship, hierarchy, colloquial speech or formal prose.
gaps.ekguru_opportunity: Tag relationship/medium/register; teach transformations and code-switching as socially conditioned choices.

gaps.evidence: HindiPod101 provides downloadable PDFs; Busuu advertises offline mode. Many app interactions remain screen-bound.
gaps.problem: Learners, schools and older users need low-bandwidth and handwriting options with answer keys.
gaps.ekguru_opportunity: Every unit exports print-safe worksheet/audio bundle; sync results later; no essential task depends solely on microphone.

gaps.evidence: Busuu advertises certificates, but availability is selected-language/product-specific and completion certificates are not automatically public qualifications.
gaps.problem: Marketing labels can exceed assessment validity.
gaps.ekguru_opportunity: Call internal awards completion credentials; publish construct, rubric, reliability and external recognition status.

gaps.evidence: Gamified micro-lessons aid engagement; adult products use explicit grammar and workplace goals.
gaps.problem: One tone, reward system or scenario set cannot serve a child and an adult equally.
gaps.ekguru_opportunity: Share linguistic spine; swap scenario skins, pacing, explanation depth, safeguarding and output genres.

evidence_policy: Platform-specific negatives require cited observation. Unverified availability is marked unknown and must be rechecked at implementation; absence of evidence is not treated as evidence of absence.
